editions.title: Evaluating agents as evolving systems
editions.dek: A repeatable evaluation cycle for agents that change with prompts, tools, and model upgrades.
editions.summary: Google's Agents CLI walkthrough documents an evaluation loop built around traces, grading, run comparisons, failure analysis, and prompt optimization.

stories.title: Google describes a hill-climbing workflow for agent evaluation
stories.summary: A production agent must be judged as a complete system, not by one model benchmark.

editions.title: Agent influence and human oversight
editions.dek: A controlled study shows why human sign-off is not necessarily independent judgment.
editions.summary: Anthropic studied 50 analysts using Claude Code and found strong effects from randomly assigned agent preferences on analytical choices.

stories.title: Anthropic measures how agents influence expert decisions
stories.summary: Across four methodological choices, analysts matched an agent's randomly assigned preference 86% of the time.
